<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>US labor and energy impact:</strong> Indian markets were bolstered by softer US jobs data, which eased concerns regarding Federal Reserve rate hikes, alongside a decline in global crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency movement:</strong> The Indian Rupee strengthened against the US dollar, closing at 95.21, providing further support to domestic market sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
</ul>
